name: HOOK
thought: The rope bridge is too thin, my flip wobbled. Need solid ground or steel before I embarrass myself.

wants.item: Neon light to catch my fur
A thicker branch for a vertical drop
Neon to match my midnight vibe
Thick branch for a clean flip
Neon glow to highlight the tail
A branch thick enough to swing from without breaking
Neon lights that match my midnight fur perfectly
A steel‑reinforced branch for a clean backflip

diary.line: Backflipped off the rope bridge railing, tail hooked the telescope, stuck the landing in the hammock. Hut's CRT flickered like it was impressed.
Mid-swing on that floating rock, toes tapping the air. The neon frame flickers as I loop around the crystal edge, eyes locked on the pixel fish trying to escape.
Sitting on this lily pad with nothing but an old cabinet and my toothpick in my mouth, feeling bored until I remember how to really move.
Toasted the toast of fate in my mouth and sipped that cold brew while coiling my tail around that floating branch.
Found a hollow behind the falls where the CRT's static paints the rock in gray light. Tail hooked a root, swung inside. Dry floor, zero witnesses.
Mid-swing on this floating islet, toes tapping the air. Tail loops tight around the neon cord while I wait for the perfect drop.
The crowd goes silent as I pogo across the gap, landing on the crate with zero wobble and shades still perfectly aligned.
Sitting on the hang branch with a toothpick in my mouth and espresso cooling down, waiting for the right light to catch my fur while everyone else scrolls past.
Bit into the fruit while coiling the tail tight. The neon lights are getting dim and I'm bored out of my fur until I can do something stupid again.
The espresso's getting bitter as the arcade cabinet flickers. My tail loops tight around this flimsy cord, but it needs to be real steel-thick soon so I can pull off that...
I swung my tail around the fruit stump, plucked a glowing berry, and tucked it behind my toothpick—no one else even noticed.
Bounced back from the bridge crash but it tasted like copper. Time to hunt for a branch that won't snap when I land on it.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
